t: What Scientific Constants Database Is All About
title: What Scientific Constants Database Is All About
description: Physical constants are nature's fixed numbers: the speed of light c = 299,792,458 m/s exactly (it defines the meter), Planck's constant h = 6.62607015e-34 J s exactly (it defines the kilogram since 2019). CODATA publishes the recommended values; the 2019 SI redefinition fixed seven constants exactly and made units derive from them. This database is the complete physical constant: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Scientific Constants Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Scientific Constants Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Scientific Constants Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: CODATA: international body publishing recommended constant values; exact constant: defined value with zero uncertainty, anchoring SI units; relative uncertainty: uncertainty divided by the value; SI redefinition (2019): units redefined from fixed constants.
definition: The working vocabulary of Scientific Constants Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: CODATA: international body publishing recommended constant values
exact constant: defined value with zero uncertainty, anchoring SI units
relative uncertainty: uncertainty divided by the value
SI redefinition (2019): units redefined from fixed constants
Kibble balance: instrument linking mass to Planck's constant
dimensionless constant: pure number like alpha, same in every unit system
